newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks higher at opening.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks higher at opening.

text.p: Wall Street stocks, supported by a strong bond market, followed through on Wednesday's strength and moved higher at the opening on Thursday.
The Dow Jones industrial average was up five at 6,351, the Nasdaq Composite up seven at 1,293 and the S&P Index up one at 733.
The 30-year bond was up 16/32 to yield 6.66 percent.
